GLMHMM Pairwise Comparison

Dedicated notebook for comparing two GLMHMM fits, especially useful for frozen-vs-unfrozen variants.

data.text/markdown:
• Comparing 3covs_2states vs 3 covs 2 states param at K=2.
  • Common cached subjects: 25 / 25.
  • 3covs_2states scoring key: stim_vals (-w).
  • 3 covs 2 states param scoring key: stim_param (-w).
  • Occupancy below uses posterior fractional occupancy averaged within session, then across sessions within subject.
  • Accuracy below uses MAP state labels from build_trial_df, averaged within subject.
